item.title: What is Tana Mongeau and Clavicular’s feud? Podcast remarks explained
item.description: Tana Mongeau criticised Kick streamer Braden “Clavicular” on her Brand Safe podcast after his livestreamed breakup with Lily Snyder. She questioned why anyone would accept being “immoral and cruel” for views and revenue while stressing that she wanted to understand the psychology behind such behaviour rather than simply judge him.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Who is Luplupka? Russian Kick streamer involved in viral AmRay livestream feud
item.description: Russian Kick streamer Luplupka is facing online attention after a livestream with autistic creator AmRay turned physical in Sri Lanka. Viral videos appear to show AmRay pouring water on her before she chased and slammed him to the ground. Earlier footage suggests tensions had already been building. Neither Luplupka nor AmRay has publicly commented on the incident so far.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Who is HMBLZAYY? The Twitch streamer who walked 3,000 miles across America and raised nearly $200K for charity
item.description: Twitch streamer HMBLZAYY finished a 3,000-mile walk across America in 124 days. He raised nearly $200,000 to build a trade school for teenagers. HMBLZAYY survived being hit by two cars during his challenging journey. His perseverance inspired thousands of viewers who followed his progress online. The streamer's mission successfully supported underserved youth and their futures.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Quote by Bob Ross: 'The very fact that you're aware of suffering is enough reason to...'
item.description: Bob Ross expressed a powerful notion regarding suffering as a testament to being alive. He suggested that without the dark shades in our lives, the brighter colors wouldn’t shine as vividly. This thought resonates with both ancient Stoic philosophers and contemporary thinkers, reinforcing that embracing pain can lead to deeper understanding and purpose amidst life's trials. Ross's insightful philosophy serves as a beacon for those facing their own challenges.

item.title: Quote by Andrei Tarkovsky: 'A book read by a thousand different people is a thousand different books'
item.description: Artistic interpretation is a reflection of the diverse experiences and perspectives of each reader. When a book is read by numerous individuals, it morphs into countless versions, each colored by personal insights. Reader-response theory emphasizes how our backgrounds inform our comprehension of texts, offering a valuable lens to tackle the complexities of modern communication and the challenges posed by digital divides.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: D4vd murder case: Court reveals Celeste Rivas allegedly threatened to kill singer before her death
item.description: Court testimony revealed text messages between D4vd and Celeste Rivas before her death. Celeste allegedly threatened D4vd one day prior to their meeting at his home. Prosecutors claim D4vd fatally stabbed and dismembered the 14-year-old. D4vd has pleaded not guilty to all charges against him. The preliminary hearing is ongoing as both sides present evidence.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Female African treefrogs mate with several males simultaneously; together they whip up...
item.description: Female African treefrogs engage in a fascinating mating ritual where multiple males collaborate to create larger foam nests. This teamwork is vital, as it shields hundreds of eggs from potential desiccation, ultimately boosting tadpole survival rates. The nesting-assistance hypothesis presents a fresh perspective on this widespread reproductive strategy, as males actively participate in nest construction and fertilization, solidifying their role in the survival of future generations.

item.title: Seth Rogen’s blunt response to YouTuber Yung Mooch sparks debate as Jonah Hill shares heartfelt career advice
item.description: A video filmed by YouTuber Yung Mooch captured an unexpected meeting with Seth Rogen and Jonah Hill on a Los Angeles production set. Rogen told Mooch not to interrupt people while they are working, while Hill offered kinder advice, telling him to enjoy life, be a kind person, and always be himself. The video was first highlighted by Dexerto.

item.description: Travis Kelce emphasizes that caring for teammates is crucial for team success. He believes a lack of concern for others makes one a terrible teammate. item.title: Hummingbird hawkmoths may have their own version of being left-handed or right-handed
item.description: Hummingbird hawkmoths exhibit a distinct preference for one eye and feeding tube side when accessing nectar. This lateralization enhances efficiency by conserving cognitive resources during intricate maneuvers. Researchers found that this trait is instinctive, evident even in their initial flower interactions. By aligning a dominant eye with a favored proboscis side, these insects streamline complex feeding tasks, showcasing a remarkable adaptation that enables problem-solving with a small brain.

item.title: In 1802, an explorer released pigs on Kangaroo Island; 224 years later, Australia has removed them
item.description: Australia celebrates a significant conservation victory with the successful removal of all feral pigs from Kangaroo Island. This initiative stands as the largest project worldwide to eradicate a persistent pest population. Launched post the devastating 2019/20 bushfires, it employed a blend of innovative technology and traditional hunting techniques to safeguard native wildlife and farming interests from potential harm.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Paramount-WB merger: Benedict Cumberbatch, Alan Cumming and Benedict Wong urge UK to block deal
item.description: Actors Benedict Cumberbatch, Alan Cumming and Benedict Wong have called on the UK government to block the proposed $111 billion Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger, warning that the deal could cause "immense harm on the British public" by threatening jobs, independent filmmaking and media diversity. Their comments come as Paramount agreed to delay completing the takeover until a U.S. court rules on whether the transaction violates antitrust laws.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
